rationale: Proposed authoring disease HPO phenotypes and MONDO ancestry as a background ontology layer, using disease-phenotype similarity to borrow latent factors for cold diseases, and explicitly not mixing phenotype terms into the target-disease core or the main message-passing graph. It was recorded as proposed at 19:31 and later adopted on the phenotype-layer branch.
subject: P-12
title: CD-0006: disease phenotype background layer for cold diseases
